question: Can all bytes and the explicit failure status of metadata_v1 be retained in the repository under the current successful-receipt registry?
decision: Archive the failed receipt and every partial output without rerunning or claiming scientific success; preserve original local files and commit history.
strongest_rival: Omitting a failed run, changing its status or silently discarding partial files could misrepresent execution and destroy evidence.
discriminator: Require the original execution_failed status and exact pre/post-copy SHA-256 equality for every file.
exposure_record: The original metadata failure, its partial output and corrected v2/v3 results are known. This is deterministic provenance preservation, not new biological analysis.
biological_unit: Not applicable: files and source-run identity only.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells, plates, tissues and assays may share mouse IDs; original Tabula Muris contributes reused young data. No external replication is claimed.
population_and_selection: Every one of the seven files produced by the failed metadata_v1 execution; no selective archiving.
contrast: Original byte stream versus archived copy; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Exact file hash equality and preservation of original failure status.
methods: Assert original receipt execution_failed; copy all four partial tables, receipt, stdout and stderr into a new run directory. Rename only the copied receipt to failed_receipt.json to avoid the wrapper receipt name. Check SHA-256 equality, export original-to-archive mapping. Do not edit, rerun or delete original files.
missingness_and_exclusions: All files present in the failed run are retained; expected outputs never produced by the failed process remain missing, not fabricated.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or biological inference.
precision_basis: Exact byte equality, no biological precision question.
interpretation_limit: Successful preservation is not successful metadata execution or scientific acceptance. failed_receipt.json remains execution_failed.
stop_rule: Stop if original status is not execution_failed, any source file is absent or a copied hash differs.
amendment_reason: Deterministic archive required because the existing validator only registers successful receipts. No governance or validator changes. Original failed files remain local and at Git commit a0565ea.
